notes: CLOSED 2026-08-30 by a native, axiom-free kernel construction (Specializes `Nat.log_aux_mono` (a new double induction on the fuel, with the value generalized inside the motive, comparing `logAux b f n` and `logAux b g m` for arbitrary `f <= g` and `n <= m`) at `f := n, g := m` with the SAME hypothesis used for both comparisons, since `log b n := logAux b n n` is diagonal.
